flags.reason: The Favorite Toggle guide's Sources note and its evidence's 0.1.78 check were made on 1 October 2026 on mirror v0.1.78 (5b6894b); the rest of the evidence on 28 September on 0.1.60. The installed package is 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02, where FavoriteToggle.tsx has changed once since (17 October): loading now draws its placeholder on its own (FavoriteToggle.tsx line 231, visible={loading === true}; Skeleton.tsx lines 134 and 272–275). Read against the installed source, every sentence this entry quotes still holds, but two are out of date and not quoted: the Anatomy note “Filled heart; its colour is meant to change when saved.” (the colour does change since #168: white while not saved, gold once saved, FavoriteToggle.tsx lines 114–123), and the evidence's Contract line “`loading` renders a same-size circular skeleton only inside `<SkeletonGroup loading>`; on its own it renders nothing.” The evidence's 0.1.60 Rendered and Limits sections (Active colours never resolve, no aria-checked, no hit slop, package default S) are superseded by its 0.1.78 check but still read as current. Re-check the guide and evidence on 0.1.78 and publish them, then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch14, for Marcin to confirm. Guide fix #538.

examples.purpose: Save a plan from its card, the guide's In context: the toggle sits in the top-right corner of the card image, and its accessibility label names the plan. The screen keeps the list of saved items; isActive and onChange stand for that wiring, which passes this card its saved state and change handler. Size is left at its default, M (29 px).

props.name: isActive
props.description: On the web the toggle carries aria-checked true or false. Declared: Whether the toggle is favorited (active) — **controlled**. When provided, the component reflects this value and defers state ownership to the parent (update it in `onChange`). Omit it to use the component uncontrolled with `defaultActive`.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Initial favorited state for **uncontrolled** usage. Ignored when `isActive` is provided. Defaults to `false`. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered inside the toggle. Defaults to the heart glyph (`ic_favorite`). Both Figma variants use the same filled heart; only its color changes with state (white when inactive, gold when active). Figma hardcodes the heart, so this prop is exposed purely for future reuse. Default "ic_favorite", from the component source.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired on press with the next (toggled) active state.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes used to resolve design tokens.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Default false, from the component source.

props.name: loading
props.description: Explicit per-instance loading override. When `true`, renders a same-size circular skeleton instead of the toggle. Defaults to inheriting from the surrounding `<SkeletonGroup>`.

props.name: ...SafePressableProps
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection FavoriteToggle reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Favorite Toggle Color
modes.description: Saved (isActive true) resolves Active: a white background, rgb(255, 255, 255), and a gold heart, rgb(206, 161, 90). Declared: A token collection FavoriteToggle reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode. Package docs: Colors resolve under `Favorite Toggle Color` Default/Active from the `isActive` prop.

modes.name: Favorite Toggle Size
modes.description: With no Favorite Toggle Size mode the toggle is 29 × 29 (M); 0.1.77 defaulted to 14 × 14 (S). Declared: A token collection FavoriteToggle reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

events.name: onChange
events.description: Fired on press with the next (toggled) active state.

gaps.text: In a web browser the tap area is only the visible circle (14 px at Small, 29 px at Medium): react-native-web ignores the 44 px hit slop the toggle sets, which phones honour. Still so on 0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Component Bug #541).
